baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative binds يطمع to the passive يُدخل and to جنة نعيم.
baseline_models.mechanism: Desire points toward a transition whose agent is withheld: the person hopes to be caused to cross into a tree-covered enclosure characterized as bestowed well-being. The passive admission makes granted access, not appetite, decisive.

activation_trace.role: Heartfelt desire and hope supply the claimant's pull toward the destination without supplying access to it.
Entry supplies the boundary crossing, while the passive form assigns that crossing to an unexpressed admitting agent.
The tree-covered garden supplies an enclosed destination rather than an abstract reward.
Pleasant well-being as bestowed favor makes bliss a gift received rather than a possession seized.

changed_reading.after: Each person hopes an admitting agency will carry him across a boundary into bestowed well-being, but desire itself supplies no access.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: كل امرئ منهم distributes the interrogated hope over singular persons drawn from a plurality.
baseline_models.mechanism: Totality scopes a singular human noun: the ayah does not leave desire at the level of a vague crowd but tests the same expectation one claimant at a time. منهم keeps each singular claim attached to the group from which it is extracted.

activation_trace.role: Totality and completeness distribute the questioned expectation across every member.
The individual person turns a collective posture into separately accountable personal claims.
Desire supplies the repeated inward expectation assigned to each person.

changed_reading.before: The crowd generally hopes for admission.
changed_reading.after: The question disaggregates the crowd and challenges a blanket presumption reproduced privately by every member.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The roots of يطمع, كل, and نعيم can align desire, total distribution, and bestowed bounty.
baseline_models.mechanism: A form-distant branch of طمع names soldiers' allotments. Held as an image rather than a gloss of the verb, it makes the universal hope resemble an expectation that bliss is pay due to every claimant.

activation_trace.role: The stipend branch contributes the form-distant image of desire recast as expected allotment.
Totality distributes the imagined allotment without exception across the claimant group.
Bestowed bounty supplies what the claimant imagines as automatically due.

changed_reading.before: Every person entertains a strong wish for bliss.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, every person behaves as though bestowed bliss were a universal allotment entered on his account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier wish tries to exchange kin and then everyone else for rescue; the focus wish seeks direct admission for each self. Read together, the passive entry becomes the last imagined self-exemption after substitution has failed.

activation_trace.role: Wishing for an outcome supplies the earlier desperate desire that the focus later individualizes.
Making one thing a ransom for another supplies the failed substitution mechanism.
Escape by separation supplies the rescue the proposed exchange is supposed to cause.
Heartfelt hope carries the rescue-seeking posture into the focus question.
The singular person identifies the beneficiary who now seeks admission for himself.
Caused entry replaces ransom as the imagined route to safety.

structural_cues: 70:10-14 moves from failed mutual concern through offered kin and all the earth as ransom to hoped-for rescue; 70:38 returns to one person drawn from a plurality.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the wish-ransom-rescue sequence and the later each-person desire; I infer a shift from substituting others to seeking one's own exempting admission. Alternatively, the two wishes may be parallel forms of desperation rather than stages of one strategy.

changed_reading.before: The ayah challenges an unsupported hope for paradise.
changed_reading.after: It also challenges a rescue logic in which each self, after imagining others as exchangeable, still expects to be admitted as the spared beneficiary.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gathering, sealing into a container, and withholding good form an acquisitive reflex. The same reflex then scripts the garden as one more good to be acquired inwardly for oneself, exposing the asymmetry between refusing outward transfer and expecting inward admission.

activation_trace.role: Gathering dispersed things into one possession supplies the acquisitive first step.
Putting something into a container supplies retention and closure after gathering.
Holding the hand back from giving supplies the blocked outward movement of good.
Desire turns the same possessive orientation toward the garden.
Passive entry supplies the inward movement the withholder expects for himself.
Bestowed good is the very kind of outward benefit the earlier human type blocks.

structural_cues: 70:18 places gathering and containing in immediate sequence; 70:19-21 generalizes an agitated human reflex and culminates in withholding good.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gather-contain-withhold and the later desire for admission; I infer that one possessive habit governs both sequences, reversing outward generosity into demanded inward access. Alternatively, the focus may criticize presumption without specifically recalling hoarding.

changed_reading.before: The claimant merely wants a desirable destination.
changed_reading.after: The claimant expects to receive and contain bestowed good while belonging to the human pattern that contains good and refuses to release it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context locates a recognized, bounded right inside wealth and directs it toward the requester and the deprived. That real allocation sharpens the focus's form-distant stipend image into a category error: blanket entitlement to bliss is imagined by persons whose relevant test is whether they recognize another's due share.

activation_trace.role: Possessed wealth supplies the finite fund within which an actual allocation is located.
A specific right owned by its holder supplies bounded entitlement rather than indiscriminate expectation.
Knowledge as disclosure makes the right recognized and determinate rather than imagined.
Request and asking identify one recipient toward whom the known right must move.
Deprivation and loss of the sought thing identify the other recipient of the allocation.
The stipend branch converts desire into an exploratory expectation of pay due.
Totality makes that imagined entitlement blanket rather than bounded.
Bestowed favor supplies the bounty incorrectly treated as automatic compensation.

structural_cues: 70:24-25 forms one compact allocation: a known right in wealth is for the requester and the deprived.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an actual bounded right and a universal desire for bestowed bliss; I use the focus's stipend branch to infer a contrast between administered obligation and imagined entitlement. Alternatively, the stipend image may be only a lexical echo and not a live legal-economic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Every person hopes to receive bliss.
changed_reading.after: Every person is exposed as treating bliss like a universal credit while the context defines entitlement through a concrete right owed outward to particular others.

context_deltas.mechanism: A sustained chain of practice, obligation, and guarding resolves in gardens plus honor before the focus asks about admission. Garden is therefore not an unqualified place available to appetite; it is the spatial outcome of a maintained relation whose social-moral quality is honor.

activation_trace.role: Specific worship opens the sustained practice sequence that precedes the garden outcome.
Obligatory fixed entitlement supplies outward responsibility within that practice sequence.
Maintaining and adhering to an obligation closes the sequence with durable practice.
The tree-covered gardens supply the explicit destination reached by the preceding description.
Commendable honor and generosity supply the relational status enjoyed there.
Bare desire is tested against the sustained sequence that precedes it.
Bestowed well-being names the hoped condition but does not replace the maintained relation.

structural_cues: 70:22-34 is a linked relative-clause sequence; 70:35 resolves it with gardens and honor, while 70:36-38 pivots to a contrasting group and its expectation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the descriptive chain and its garden-honor resolution; I infer that the sequence functions as a formation or eligibility contrast to bare appetite. Alternatively, it may describe two populations without specifying a causal admission test.

changed_reading.before: Garden admission is a desired destination considered by itself.
changed_reading.after: Garden and bliss are the culmination of maintained worship, obligation, and guarding, so the question contrasts formed honor with ungrounded appetite.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate context arranges a converging crowd by facing, forward haste, and right-left flanks. كل امرئ then breaks that spatial mass into singular claimants: bodily convergence does not create collective access, and each member privately carries the same presumption.

activation_trace.role: Face-to-face orientation supplies the crowd's directed convergence before the question.
Hastening forward adds kinetic pressure to the converging arrangement.
The right-hand direction supplies one organized flank of the crowd.
The left-hand direction supplies the opposing flank and completes the encircled geometry.
Totality distributes the question through every body in the spatial mass.
The singular person makes each crowd member individually carry the admission claim.

structural_cues: The plural bodies and side-grouping of 70:36-37 switch abruptly to the distributive singular كل امرئ in 70:38.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies converging spatial cues and the subsequent distributive singular; I infer that the syntax exposes a crowd as many replicated private claims rather than one qualified body. Alternatively, the singular may simply generalize without criticizing crowd dynamics.

changed_reading.before: Every individual independently hopes for entry.
changed_reading.after: A physically convergent crowd is verbally disassembled, showing that proximity, speed, and group formation cannot pool into admission for any one member.

context_deltas.mechanism: The answer relocates agency from the desiring person to the one who creates, has effective capacity, can substitute a better population, and cannot be outstripped. The passive admission is thus controlled by the same agency before which each claimant is contingent and replaceable.

activation_trace.role: Origination and bringing into existence supply the claimant's dependence on a prior agent.
Effective capacity reaching action and control supplies the power behind admission or refusal.
One thing standing in another's place supplies the population-replacement mechanism.
Excellence and selection supply the comparative standard for the proposed replacement.
Escaping beyond a pursuer supplies the possibility explicitly denied to the claimants.
Passive entry becomes one operation within the creator's effective control.
Each person is recast from presumed beneficiary to contingent created instance.

structural_cues: 70:39 begins with a direct negation immediately after the question; 70:40-41 expands from creation to cosmic lordship, capacity, replacement, and non-evasion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negation, creation, capacity, replacement, and non-evasion; I infer that the unexpressed agent of passive admission is the same sovereign agent, so entitlement collapses under creaturely replaceability. Alternatively, the denial may target this crowd specifically rather than every form of hope.

changed_reading.before: Applicants await a decision about entry.
changed_reading.after: Created and replaceable persons presume upon an admission power held entirely by an agent they can neither constrain nor outrun.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hoped motion is passive entry into an enclosed good; the disclosed motion is exit from graves followed by rapid movement toward an erected marker. This spatial reversal replaces elective inward reception with compelled outward exposure and directed assembly.

activation_trace.role: Passage to the outside supplies the exact directional counter-motion to hoped entry.
The grave supplies the enclosing origin from which the persons actually emerge.
Speed opposed to slowness supplies urgency in the disclosed movement.
An erected boundary marker supplies the visible target organizing the rush.
Entry supplies the inward motion whose direction and voluntariness are reversed.
Hope supplies the imagined motion displaced by the disclosed one.

structural_cues: The branchless root و ف ض at 70:43 is used only structurally: يُوفضون reinforces rapid directed movement toward the marker and is not branch-cited.
The passive يُدخل in 70:38 and plural active يخرجون in 70:43 reverse both direction and how the moving persons appear grammatically.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed entry and exit, a grave origin, speed, and a target marker; I infer a deliberate spatial reversal from imagined inward admission to compelled outward summons. Alternatively, these may be successive eschatological scenes rather than one contrastive motion model.

changed_reading.before: Each person imagines being moved inward into a garden.
changed_reading.after: The context replaces that wished-for inward crossing with outward emergence from enclosure and a hurried, exposed movement toward an assigned marker.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's hoped well-being stands between two status endpoints: persons in gardens are honored, whereas the appointed promised day ends with lowered eyes and disgrace covering the crowd. The question is therefore about which status will be bestowed or imposed, not location alone.

activation_trace.role: Commendable honor supplies the positive social status paired with gardens.
A promise fixed to a time or place supplies the authorized appointment that replaces subjective expectation.
Lowering and submission supply the bodily status opposed to honor.
Overtaking and overpowering supply the imposed movement by which disgrace covers them.
Brokenness under compulsion supplies the negative status that answers presumptive honor.
Bestowed well-being supplies the positive condition each claimant expects.
Enticement and induced expectation distinguish subjective hope from an authorized promise.

structural_cues: Garden-honor at 70:35 precedes the focus, while the repeated promised-day formula at 70:42 and 70:44 closes on humbled eyes and covering disgrace.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies honor before the question and an appointed humiliation after it; I infer that the focus contrasts self-induced expectation with the status actually assigned at the promised time. Alternatively, the framing may contrast populations without making promise and desire competing authorizations.

changed_reading.before: The claimant expects a pleasant place.
changed_reading.after: The claimant expects bestowed honor, but the authorized appointment discloses an imposed status of lowered, overpowered disgrace instead.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links two different semantic domains through the image of covering. It remains anchored by the immediate description at 70:36 and the focus root of جنة, but downstream prose should present it only as a lexical-material irony, never as an equation of disbelief with garden.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The people described immediately before the focus by كفر seek جنة, whose root also carries covering and concealment.

activation_trace.role: Concealing truth supplies the harmful covering practiced by the claimant group.
Covering from perception supplies the shared material image in the desired destination.
The tree-covered garden turns concealment into the beneficial shelter they seek.

changed_reading.before: Those who conceal truth nevertheless want a garden.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, those marked by a destructive covering presume upon admission into a beneficial covering, producing a material irony of concealment and shelter.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the decoy is a nominal, form-distant branch while the focus uses the ordinary verb of desire. The image remains anchored in طمع and the ayah's passive entry into an enclosure; downstream prose should call it a decoy analogy and must not translate يطمع as being trapped or imply a hidden agent's motive.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sequence يطمع ... يُدخل جنة joins desire, caused entry, and an enclosed destination.

activation_trace.role: The decoy bird placed inside a net supplies a form-distant image of attraction organized around an enclosure.
Caused entry supplies the movement toward the attractive enclosure without granting the desirer control.
The tree-covered garden supplies the bounded attractive space around which desire gathers.

changed_reading.before: The garden is simply the object of desire.
changed_reading.after: As a contained lexical analogy, the attractive enclosure also exposes how desire can draw a claimant toward a scene whose access and outcome he does not control.

strongest_changes: The passive admission became a question of agency: created and replaceable claimants cannot convert appetite into granted access.
The ethical sequence and its garden-honor result changed paradise from a free-standing prize into the outcome of maintained worship, outward obligation, and guarding.
The final exit from graves reversed hoped inward entry into compelled outward exposure and rapid directed assembly.
The hoarding and known-right sequences recast universal hope as an asymmetry between demanded inward benefit and blocked outward benefit.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses appetite, distributive individuality, passive boundary crossing, enclosure, and bestowed ease into one question. Context repeatedly changes the same compact mechanism by altering agency, entitlement, motion, and status without requiring one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The stipend and decoy activations depend on form-distant branches and should remain explicit lexical analogies.
The formation or eligibility arrow inferred from 70:22-35 is stronger than a mere contrast but is not grammatically stated as a causal rule.
The entry-exit reversal may be deliberate spatial counterpoint or simply the juxtaposition of successive eschatological scenes.
The ransom sequence may explain the later self-admission wish, or both may independently express desperation and presumption.
